page_title: LIV 0-1 NOT | Liverpool v Nottingham Forest 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
90+2' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is booked.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' A dangerous towering header by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
88' The referee awards a corner and Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take it.
88' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
87' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
86' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
85' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Alisson is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
84' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Mohamed Salah, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
83' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jota Silva (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Chris Wood cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morato (Nottingham) replacing Morgan Gibbs-White.
80' Substitution. Neco Williams (Nottingham) has come on for Alex Moreno.
80' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
76' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Matz Sels easily makes the save.
75' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Ibrahima Konate will be replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
75' Substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) on for Andrew Robertson.
74' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a long ball forward to Cody Gakpo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.

72' 0 - 1 GOAL! Anthony Elanga finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from mid range. It’s 0:1.
70' Matz Sels blocks Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool)'s effort from the edge of the box.
70' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

69' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
68' Morgan Gibbs-White slides a brilliant pass into Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.

66' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Matz Sels (Nottingham). Matz Sels (Nottingham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
66' A long pass finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
64' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
62' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) gets a yellow card.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Elliot Anderson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
61' Here is a change. Luis Diaz is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
60' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Diogo Jota is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
60' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Mac Allister leaves the pitch and Conor Bradley (Liverpool) comes on.
58' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tries to find Andrew Robertson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
54' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) replaces Nicolas Dominguez.
53' Trent Alexander-Arnold plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
53' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.

52' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Matz Sels thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
51' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is caught offside once again.
50' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Michael Oliver blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
44' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
43' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
41' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
39' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
37' Matz Sels pulls off a brilliant save! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
36' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes it short.
36' The corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is intercepted by Matz Sels. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.

35' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Andrew Robertson was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:1. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
29' The corner is sent into the box by Andrew Robertson, but Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) flashes the ball a whisker past the left post.
29' There's an opportunity for Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
29' An attempted cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is cleared. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nottingham was in an offside position.
27' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
27' Chris Wood (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find Diogo Jota, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
25' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels was alert and made an amazing save!
24' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
21' The game is interrupted now, Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Mohamed Salah plays a short lofted pass to Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
17' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
16' Chris Wood (Nottingham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
14' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ola Aina. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
14' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) trips an opposition player and Michael Oliver signals a foul.
11' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
8' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
5' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
1' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
